scope: One authored two-node/three-field source; three ordered suites repeated twice per workload. Fresh construction calls the frozen model at most once. Paired saved workloads make zero new predictions: one retained CLI command versus six sequential stateless CLI commands (startup count differs); three paired trials per deterministic/FP32 mode, alternating workflow order. One fresh ternary pilot per profile. Current inputs, actual values and deliberate partial expectations are independently checked. CPU/RSS include builds and children; whole-host utilization, new training and broad model quality are unmeasured.
